channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trayce Jackson-Davis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trayce Jackson-Davis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Trayce Jackson-Davis
item.description:
“Once we added Melt, once we knew GP and Wiggs were healthy and looking good, once we decided to play bigger with Trayce [Jackson-Davis] and Draymond, it just made sense. Jerry really pushed for it and he’s been great at teaching it. But it’s a combination really of personnel and what makes the most sense for our team. Wouldn’t have made sense last year.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Trayce Jackson-Davis, Nov 15, 2024. Source: San Francisco Standard.

item.title: Draymond Green on Trayce Jackson-Davis
item.description:
Green said after the game.

“So the things that I do off of instinct or reading the game on the fly, it's harder to do. If I just go run over here to cover up something I see needs to be covered, that's leaving the rim unprotected ... but if I know the rim is protected by Trayce, I can just go do it.”

Draymond Green on Trayce Jackson-Davis, Apr 16, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Draymond Green on Trayce Jackson-Davis
item.description:
“Not necessarily chances gambling for a steal, but to clog the paint up, make extra rotations. If I’m the five, I’m the last line of defense. The things that I do off of instinct, reading the game on the fly, it’s hard to do that at the five because you’re anchoring everybody. So if I just run over here to cover up something but I’m the five, that’s leaving the rim unprotected. But if I know the rim is protected with Trayce, I’ll just go do it.”

Draymond Green on Trayce Jackson-Davis, Apr 5, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Trayce Jackson-Davis, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the if he'll keep the Draymond-Jackson-Davis combination together as starters after Kuminga returns:

“My philosophy is always if you're playing well, you keep doing the same thing.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Trayce Jackson-Davis, Jonathan Kuminga, Apr 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Trayce Jackson-Davis
item.description:
Kerr onTJD:

“I know I can trust him. We’ve got to get Trayce more minutes to get him ready for the playoffs because he needs reps, he needs more time.”

Steve Kerr on Trayce Jackson-Davis, Mar 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Brandin Podziemski on Trayce Jackson-Davis
item.description:
“Teams are used to guarding our play style, meaning Steph and Klay, and then I feel like the elements that me, JK, Trayce and Moses bring, it's something different. Other teams are like, 'OK, wait -- now they have this and that.'”

Brandin Podziemski on Trayce Jackson-Davis, Jan 4, 2024. Source: ESPN.
